detail.longDescription: My new paper can now be found on the # arXiv ( https:// arxiv.org/abs/2608.19424 ), in addition to my website. I haven't posted to the arXiv in a little while and things have changed. I was glad to see that we don't need to supply bbl files anymore and can finally just submit bib files instead. It was also nice to see a choice of # TeXLaTeX compilers, but still no # LuaLaTeX , so I did have to cut the Japanese text from the paper. I did used to have a way to do this with # PDFLaTeX but the LuaLaTeX way is so much cleaner I don't even want to mess with the old way now. I have mixed feelings about the arXiv. I wish I didn't feel like I had to post there for legitimacy or exposure, and things haven't gotten evil enough for me to bail, but I'm feeling like it's time to think about how to live without it. Posting papers to my website is a start, but it doesn't seem like the whole solution. # academia # research # math # mathematics
